sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Even though the Priestly Blessing preceded the blossoming of Aharon's staff, the staff's flowering added a superior quality, like a legal document strengthened by challenge, and this explains the concept of "good almonds" in Likkutei Torah.

translations.translation: And it may be said,
that even though the Priestly Blessing was before Aharon's staff blossomed and produced almonds,
as it is written,
"And Aharon lifted his hands toward the people and blessed them," and Rashi explains: "He blessed them with the Priestly Blessing"
[and even then the drawing down of the Priestly Blessing was with speed],
nevertheless,
after Aharon's staff blossomed, an elevation was added to this.
For since the matter of the blossoming of Aharon's staff etc. and producing almonds came about through the challenge to the priesthood,
this is
analogous to a document that had a challenge issued against it and was upheld in court,
which has greater force than a document that had no challenge against it.
And like the advantage of light from darkness.
And based on this, we may explain what is said in Likkutei Torah at the conclusion of the maamar,
that there is a "shkidah" (alacrity/almond) for the "motav" (better) and for the "tov" (good),
and that the almonds of Aharon's staff are good almonds,
it may be said,

that this which the maamar brings, that there is a "shkidah" for the "motav," is to hint that in the good almonds of Aharon's staff there is also the quality of the transformation of "motav" into "tov."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The confirmation of Aharon's priesthood through almonds, which signify speed, relates to the transformation of "motav" to "tov," because true speed involves a vessel of peace that enables unlimited blessing even below.

translations.translation: And we may add,
that this confirmation of Aharon's priesthood after the challenge was through "and it produced almonds,"
whose significance is speed
(as above in section 1),
is because the quality of the transformation of "motav" to "tov" is also related to the matter of speed.
And the explanation of this may be said,
for the matter of speed is that even when the influence is drawn down to the lowest levels, it is with great abundance
(as above in section 8).
And in order that even below there should be an abundance of influence,
the lower realm must be a vessel for this.
And it may be said,
that one of the reasons that the conclusion and seal of the Priestly Blessing is "and may He grant you peace,"
is,
that the vessel for abundant blessing,
even to unlimited abundance
[for the abundance of influence of the Priestly Blessing is
(in its root)
unlimited abundance,
and as above that the root of the influence of the Priestly Blessing is above the chain of descent],
is peace,
for the Holy One, blessed be He, found no vessel that holds blessing for Israel except peace.
And based on this, we may explain the connection of the quality of transformation to the matter of the speed of almonds,
for the true essence of speed is,

that this—that even below the influence is in abundance—is not only because the drawing down from above is not delayed, but also because the lower realm is a vessel for this through the peace within it,
and the true essence of peace is when even the "motav" is transformed into "tov."

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The ultimate perfection of this peace, where even the enemy becomes a friend, will be at the coming of Moshiach, when Jerusalem will dwell open without limits.

translations.translation: And the ultimate perfection of this peace
(that even the enemy is turned into a friend)
will be with the coming of Moshiach Tzidkeinu, speedily and truly,
for then there will be peace in abundance and blessing in abundance,
unlimited abundance,
as it is written,
"Jerusalem will dwell open,"
without measurements and limitations.
